about_short_description.short_description: Gullak.Money aims to create an all-inclusive ecosystem of saving which is accessible to all.

product.name: Gullak Gold+
product.description: A digital gold investment product that offers users the ability to invest in gold with an assured extra 5% gold grams annually on top of market appreciation, with no lock-in period and flexible withdrawal options.

product.name: Daily Savings Plan
product.description: A savings feature that enables users to set up automatic daily savings starting from ₹50 per day, with options to pause, edit, or withdraw funds anytime.

product.name: Save on Every Spend Feature
product.description: An automated investment feature that invests a small amount in gold on behalf of users every time they make an online expense.

product.name: Physical Gold Delivery
product.description: A service that allows users to receive physical gold coins delivered to their doorstep based on their digital gold investments.

product.name: Gold Investment Calculator
product.description: An online tool that helps users calculate potential returns on gold investments through lump sum or systematic investment plans (SIPs).
